summary: Explore our Emerging Markets and Financial Development Training Course to enhance your skills and knowledge in global finance and investment strategies.
lede: Emerging-market financial development examines how institutions, policy, and capital flows shape financing and investment decisions. For investment, public-sector, and development professionals, the course covers reading market indicators, assessing financial systems and policy risks, and applying those insights to investment, lending, and program design.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals who regularly make or influence decisions in emerging and developing markets.
audience: Investment officers, analysts, and portfolio managers
modules: Reading the Macro and Policy Environment
Capital Flows, Local Currency Markets, and Investor Behavior
Banking, Credit, and Financial Inclusion in Emerging Markets
Risk, Shock, and Resilience in Emerging Markets
Designing and Communicating Emerging Market Strategies
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of economic principles and experience in finance, investment, or development sectors.
